Wikipedia and Ballotpedia list no lawsuits, charges or ethics findings; the only controversy noted is 2022 criticism over council use of a city-owned Footprint Center suite. News search 2026-10-14 (her name with ethics complaint/lawsuit/OCC): no case or complaint against her found. Ethics: Office of Congressional Conduct (formerly OCE) public investigations table read directly, all pages covering Oct 2016–Mar 4, 2026 (pages 1–5 of 13): no referral names her. The table excludes matters closed in preliminary review and dismissals the Committee accepted. ethics.house.gov (the Ethics Committee's own statements) was refused by the fetch tool and could not be read; no Committee action was found in news.
